notesStmt.note: This manuscript was likely composed in the early 1880s, sometime before August 1885.

These draft lines contain slight similarities to the poem "Last of Ebb, and Daylight Waning." The poem was first published in Nineteenth Century magazine in August 1885, as part of a cluster of poems titled "Fancies at Navesink." The cluster, including this poem, then appeared in November Boughs (1888).
